body: I felt a sudden surge of curiosity as I approached the stamp-covered slip. My heart raced slightly at the prospect of getting closer and seeing more details. With caution but an eager mind, I moved slowly towards the archive desk. The stamp, though clearly marked 'REFUSED', bore a faint pattern beneath the ink that seemed too intricate to be mundane. As my fingers brushed against its surface, a warm sensation spread through me, almost like a tingling that had always been there yet now was intensified. I could only wonder at this inexplicable attraction—perhaps something about those letters held secrets or stories untold.
